en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town square with early 20th‑century buildings surrounding an open market area. The roofs are steep and tiled, with dormer windows. Several shopfronts line the ground floors, including a bakery and café, and signage is in German. A few people stand or walk in the largely empty square. At the top left, printed text identifies the scene as "Neustadt i. Sa., Markt."
